en: A black-and-white image depicting an outdoor religious service attended by a congregation. The backdrop is a natural, leafy cave or grotto. The priest is standing at an altar, and people are gathered around, many with heads bowed. One woman in white attire is prominently visible in the foreground. The caption at the bottom is in French and reads: '121. - VERRIA. - Une Messe en plein air'. There is also a watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' on the image.
